name: Askitari Girls Growth Potions Pibell's Pharmacy
source:
Pibell opens his pharmacy in Ramalien one more day. This time she is alone to serve the entire public and what seems like a normal day like any other will be disturbed by the arrival of some peculiar clients. Can Pibell survive the day?

This little kinetic novel continues the story of Askitari Girls: growth potions by telling a parallel story.
